notes.text: This sheet has no separate authorial number. The lower-left 71 is thinner, lighter foliation in another hand. Under Remarque, the manuscript returns to two contexts of quoted deploiement and lists conditions a), b), c) on the written ordered topological spaces. The first marginal star note reads en deux sens assez différents and is attached to the star above the closing quotation mark.

The manuscript calls the s map a fibration propre and the b map an immersion propre, then writes the x,y condition and an inserted reformulation. Its angled margin calls c) a consequence of a), b) with the additional rare and finite-dimension wording. These are accounts of what the manuscript states; no proof of those claims was attempted while transcribing.

The body describes a type-I situation using Sigma as a coproduct of the X_i and a second coproduct indexed by i,j tels que X_i subset X_j. It then writes s est étale with the doubtful short parenthesis localt fini donc, and later calls b bordant in the theory developed ici. The phrase about applying le sorite du I-tilde=pi_0(Sigma) and the final X_i-star complement expression are reported as the author's wording. The reading decisions use the visible letters and indices, not an inferred theorem.

The darkest crowding occurs around the condition-c insertion and the brown clause Dans un cas (celui d'une notion assez anodine. The insertion's terminal words stay doubtful. The edge word anodine leads without the unsupported analogue à candidate; a separate lower brown closing curve after it is retained as an uncertain parenthesis because its top meets the paper edge. The next phrase visibly contains notion and a tall l, with initial de la/la uncertain. The witnesses' contexte/certain candidates are not used to fill that overlap.

The cancelled theory word favours présente, but proposed readings remain in place because développée crosses it. The final cancelled phrase preserves the visibly shortened remp/rempl, the partial ito/itou, the open parallel-shaft sign and exact; no longer ending is supplied. No separate extra cancelled token could be isolated at the right end of the c insertion or after Sigma in the consequence margin, where neighbouring writing overlaps.

Local placement is retained: the a-source degree is lowered, the final a degree and both b degrees sit on their Sigma baselines, and the consequence-margin star follows the closing degree parenthesis. Separate underlines and right heads are present in both a and b maps. The tiny point above-left of the a equality, the point between its row and b, and the two points below the pi-zero closing parenthesis are recorded by position without assigning a new mathematical or punctuation value.

The first quoted deploiement has no detached acute over its first e; the nearby descender comes from Remarque. The singular/plural ending of the first stratification remains open. Short ds, m-bar, localt, comp., dim and remp/rempl forms are preserved. The donnant parenthesis is not completed before the visible semicolon. H's final section heading and its initial/side editorial notes are not written source text on this leaf and are excluded from the transcription and textual-change counts.
